job.question: Which retirement system's general investment consultant RFP requires respondents to currently provide non-discretionary general investment advice to at least 5 public pension plans larger than $5 billion and at least 2 public plans over $20 billion?
job.acceptance: TMRS or the full system name is sufficient; repeating thresholds is optional.

reviews.reason: This is BERS’s investment consulting RFP, not the RFP for the retirement system in question. Its minimum qualifications do not include the specified public-pension client thresholds.
quotes: This Request for Proposals (“RFP”) is issued by the NYC Board of Education Retirement System (“BERS” or the “Agency”).
Proposer(s) must have a minimum of 7 (seven) years’ experience in the provision of investment consulting services to institutional clients.
If available, please include a reference for at least one public pension fund.
